scientific_integrity: The binary coefficient-one criterion is acknowledged as prior mathematics; the new claim concerns the marker-conditioned ternary class and its exact enumeration. Neither authorship, precedence, nor independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only ternary words with exactly one distinguished symbol and scattered subsequences of length at most two; not an all-marker result. Finite verification is corroborative. Publication priority against unindexed descriptions and independent proof validation remain open.
title: Exact growth and regularity of one-marker 2-binomial singleton words
